arguments.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PENPROBE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED PIC 9(4) VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED PIC 9(4) VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS PIC S9(5) VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-SLA-BREACH-DAY PIC 9(4) VALUE ZERO.
01 WS-PENALTY-AMT PIC 9(7)V99 VALUE ZERO.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
ACCEPT WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED.
ACCEPT WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED.
IF WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED > 7
   COMPUTE WS-SLA-BREACH-DAY = WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED - (WS-WORK-DAYS-ELAPSED - 7)
   COMPUTE WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS = WS-CAL-DAYS-ELAPSED - WS-SLA-BREACH-DAY
   COMPUTE WS-PENALTY-AMT = 500 * WS-DELAY-CAL-DAYS
ELSE
   MOVE ZERO TO WS-PENALTY-AMT
END-IF.
DISPLAY 'PENALTY: ' WS-PENALTY-AMT.
STOP RUN.
